title: The Frank answer to the question
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：frank　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 frank 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the keeper wrote of ① a frank answer to the question in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② franker than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the frank ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the frankest answer to the question anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1952 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too frank to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the frank ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a frank talk in the kitchen, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as frank as the talk in the kitchen they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was frank or not, and he said so.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something frank, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite frank; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the frank ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968, in public, she wrote of another frank answer to the question in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ franker than anybody had expected. ⑩ The frankest talk in the kitchen in the whole tower, she said in 1970, was the one she could never quite name; the frank ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 坦率（前置定语 a frank answer to the question：1958 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件坦率的回答）
B. adj. 坦率／直白（比较级 franker than：文中两处，一处比坦率的回答，一处比预想）
C. adj. 坦率／直白（最高级 the frankest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 坦率（表语 too frank to do：母亲觉得它太坦率，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 直白（前置定语 a frank talk in the kitchen：叔叔把整件事称作一桩直白的坦诚交谈）
F. adj. 直白（同级比较 as frank as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厨房里的坦诚交谈相比）
G. adj. 直白（后置定语 something frank：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 直白（受程度副词修饰 quite frank：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a frank answer to the question
the frankest answer to the question anybody
a frank talk in the kitchen
The frankest talk in the kitchen in

answers.why: frank 意为“坦率”，1958 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件坦率的回答”，此处作前置定语 a frank answer to the question。
frank 意为“坦率”，此处用比较级 franker than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
frank 意为“坦率”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最坦率的一件，故用最高级 the frankest answer to the question。
frank 意为“坦率”，母亲认为这件东西“太坦率了，谁也用不上”，too frank to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
frank 意为“直白”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩直白的坦诚交谈”，此处作前置定语 a frank talk in the kitchen。
frank 意为“直白”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厨房里的坦诚交谈一样直白”，同级比较用 as frank as。
frank 意为“直白”，年历上那半行字要的是“直白的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something frank。
frank 意为“直白”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当直白”，quite 修饰原级 frank。
frank 意为“直白”，1968 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要直白”，故用比较级 franker than。
frank 意为“直白”，母亲 1970 年说的是“整个钟楼里最直白的那一桩”，故用最高级 the frankest talk in the kitchen。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件坦率的回答。（a frank answer to the question）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更坦率。（franker than …）
母亲觉得它太坦率，谁也用不上。（too frank to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩直白的坦诚交谈。（a frank talk in the kitchen）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厨房里的坦诚交谈一样直白。（as frank as …）
到了 1965 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件直白的东西。（something frank）
answers: In 1958 the keeper wrote of a frank answer to the question in the calendar.
Everybody said it was franker than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too frank to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a frank talk in the kitchen.
He said nobody would call it as frank as the talk in the kitchen they had once had.
By 1965 the calendar asked for nothing but something frank.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 frank 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the keeper wrote of a frank answer to the question in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the frankest answer to the question in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too frank to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a frank talk in the kitchen, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite frank, and everybody laughed.
The frank ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
